none: PAS BH-E11856: 2017T1090: fragment of a silver gilt pendant made from an Early Medieval penny
contea di ritrovamento: Essex (Inghilterra e Galles)

Date: late tenth/eleventh century. Dimensions: Weight: 0.9g. Thickness: 2.9mm. Length: 17.6mm. Width: 9.9mm. Description: Incomplete silver gilt penny which has been mounted as a pendant by the addition of a ring, which is passed through a ribbed suspension loop riveted to the coin itself. A section of the outer edge of the coin is all that remains. The fitting is unusually substantial, relative…
